record.paper_title: Structural results on circular-arc graphs and circle graphs: A survey and the main open problems
record.original_question: For each nonnegative integer q, find a forbidden induced subgraph characterization for q-proper circular-arc graphs. A circular-arc graph is an intersection graph of open arcs on a circle. The term q-proper circular-arc graph is defined analogously to q-proper interval graphs: it should admit a circular-arc model in which any one arc is contained in at most q other arcs. The problem is to identify the induced obstructions that exactly characterize this restricted circular-arc model class.

evidence.quote: Problem 6. Find a characterization by forbidden induced subgraphs for q-proper circular-arc graphs.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A circular-arc graph is the intersection graph of a family of open arcs on a circle; such a family is called a circular-arc model of the graph. For a nonnegative integer q, call a graph G a q-proper circular-arc graph if G admits a circular-arc model in which every arc is properly contained in at most q other arcs of the model. (Thus 0-proper circular-arc graphs are exactly the proper circular-arc graphs.)

Problem: For each fixed nonnegative integer q, determine the complete list of minimal forbidden induced subgraphs that characterizes the class of q-proper circular-arc graphs. Equivalently, describe explicitly all graphs H such that H is not a q-proper circular-arc graph but every proper induced subgraph of H is.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches turn up forbidden-induced-subgraph characterizations for related restricted classes (proper circular-arc graphs, proper circular-arc bigraphs, normal Helly circular-arc graphs, circular-arc graphs within split graphs), but no characterization for the q-proper circular-arc graph class for general q. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Forbidden structure characterization of circular-arc graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizations for restricted subclasses of circular-arc graphs by forbidden structures; no q-proper variant addressed.
status_evidence.claim: No forbidden induced subgraph characterization for q-proper circular-arc graphs is given.

status_evidence.title: Forbidden Induced Subgraphs of Normal Helly Circular-Arc Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Characterization for normal Helly circular-arc graphs, a different subclass.
status_evidence.claim: Related subclasses have been characterized but not q-proper circular-arc graphs.

status_evidence.title: Circularly compatible ones, D-circularity, and proper circular-arc bigraphs
status_evidence.snippet: Minimal forbidden induced subgraph characterization for proper circular-arc bigraphs.
status_evidence.claim: Characterizations exist for proper (q=0) related variants only.
